title: Nine Yards and One Feather
subtitle: 弓箭与射艺 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 弓箭与射艺（文学艺术与体育·体育运动）
meta: 主题语境：弓箭与射艺（文学艺术与体育·体育运动）　|　核心词汇：arrow　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 arrow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my uncle made ① an arrow out of a stick and nine inches of wire, and my grandfather said that was how it started. The ② arrow, meaning the thing in the air and not the mark it leaves, was gone in a second and remembered for years; an arrow, he said, is the only thing you can throw that tells you where you were standing. He said that is why he never threw one himself.

Every ③ arrow he owned had a name and a weight, and he said an unnamed arrow will not fly straight. Their  arrow — the one that won in 1961 — had a blue feather and no wire at all; an arrow, my father said, is nine parts patience and one part letting go. He said the letting go is the part nobody practises.

My grandmother meant the other thing: she followed the painted ④ arrow on the wall, and it led her to the wrong room twice. The ⑤ arrow sign, meaning the mark and not the weapon, is the only thing in a building that is certain about something it has never seen; an arrow, she said, is a sentence without a verb in it. She said the building had nine of them.

By 1968 he could put nine ⑥ arrows in a nine-inch circle at ninety yards, and he never entered a competition. The ⑦ arrow he kept on the mantel was the first one, wire and all; an arrow, my mother said, is the only thing you keep that was made in order to be lost. She said he had eleven more in a box.

The  arrow I remember is the one that missed and stuck in the barn door for nine years. An ⑧ arrow, he said in 1979, is the only thing that is only itself while it is moving; every arrow, he said, is a straight line with an apology at the end of it. He said the one in the barn door never apologised.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 箭（一支具体的箭）
B. n. 箭（指飞行中的那支箭，与留下的痕迹相对）
D. 固定搭配：make an arrow 制作一支箭
E. n. 箭头；箭号（墙上的指示标志）
G. n. 箭（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 箭（指壁炉架上留着的那支）

items.q: an arrow out of a stick
The arrow, meaning the thing in the air
the painted arrow on the wall
The arrow he kept on the mantel

answers.why: make an arrow 意为“制作一支箭”，1954 年叔叔用一根树枝和九英寸铁丝做了一支箭，祖父说事情就是从那儿开始的。
arrow 指“飞行中的那支箭”，与它留下的痕迹相对，一秒钟就没了，却被记住许多年。
arrow 意为“箭”，他拥有的每一支箭都有名字和重量，他说没有名字的箭飞不直。
arrow 意为“箭头、箭号”，墙上那个画着的箭头，把她领错了两次房间。
arrow 作定语，arrow sign 意为“箭号标志”，指标记而不是武器，它是建筑里唯一对从未见过的东西十分确定的东西。
arrows 为复数，意为“多支箭”，到 1968 年他能在九十码外把九支箭射进一个九英寸的圆里。
arrow 指壁炉架上留着的那支箭，也就是最早那支，铁丝什么都还在。
arrow 为抽象总称，泛指“箭这种东西”，他说箭是唯一只有在飞行时才是它自己的东西。
